notes.title: Steam Achievements and Major Text Overhaul
notes.content:
Greetings, adventurers!

We're thrilled to present our most significant update since launch, packed with improvements and fixes. Dive into a more immersive Neoproxima with Steam achievements and enhanced narrative quality!

[list]
[*] Text overhaul: Numerous grammatical and typographical fixes, plus rewording for a smoother reading experience. (Special thanks to Rin, Charles, Baxder, evolgenius, Daenis, Sasha, STANN.co, Alexbattledust, polyabolo, John Walker, Flynn, Clément, and Tabea for their valuable feedback!)
[*] Steam Achievements: Can you unlock them all? (Achievements are unlocked at the end of a loop)
[*] Cloud save functionality enabled
[*] Fixed input glitches during certain game events (hard to tell exactly what the fix is without spoiling :x)
[*] Improved animations during adventures
[*] Resolved erroneous conditions and potential soft locks (Thanks to Charles, Maëva, and Nick for their insights!)
[*] Updated encyclopedia entries (Kudos to ZpQ for the feedback!)
[/list]

We'd like to express our heartfelt gratitude to all of you for your ongoing feedback. While we couldn't address every suggestion due to time constraints, your input has been instrumental in shaping this update. We truly value all your feedback and suggestions! ❤️

The Neoproxima Team

notes.title: Quickfix
notes.content:
We identified an issue with our implementation of Steam Cloud Save. This fix disables cloud saves for the moment so that local saves works consistantly.

We will re-enable the feature when we are confident it works correctly.

Feel free to check the [url=http://discord.gg/m3cNq3y63H]Discord[/url] for tips, advices or support obout the game features and saves 🙏

notes.title: Time to leave Earth and aim for space - Neoproxima is available now!
notes.content:
Hello, earthers! 

The launch at Baikonur went well, and the two months of FTL travel are ending. We are now approaching space elevator number 24.

It's time that you get accustomed with Neoproxima;

[list]
[*] Explore freely: using your small truck, explore the colony’s surroundings and find ways to attain your objectives
[*] Plan carefully: chose those objectives for each loop, and use your willpower points, items, and characters accordingly
[*] Death is not absolute: don’t be afraid to take risks and explore Neoproxima. You will be back anew
[*] A galaxy-scaled intrigue in a uchronia setting: discover an alternate history in which the cold-war expanded to space, and uncover mysteries going further than you might imagine
[*] Character-centric: Meet the colorful colonists, observe the effect of the time loop on them, and yourself
[/list]

We hope you enjoy exploring the planet. Feel free to leave us a review.

Your flight crew - aka the development team

notes.title: Demo updated, release approaching
notes.content:
We want to thank all the players that tested the demo and provided us with awesome feedback during Steam Next Fest last month.

We are working hard to prepare for the full release - on the 25th - and are updating the demo accordingly. It's not longer than before, but all the issues you found should have been fixed.

A big shoutout to the streamers that took time to play the demo, it's always a stressful yet heartwarming  moment for the team, and it was a lot of fun.
